name: Bridge with Magic Circle
summary: Bridge with a magic circle between the knees, squeezing at the top.

layers.title: Bridge and squeeze
layers.text: Squeeze the ring at the top.

layers.title: Hold and pulse
layers.text: Stay up and pulse the ring.

layers.title: Roll down holding the squeeze
layers.text: Keep the ring pressed all the way to the mat.

cues:
Squeeze the ring as you lift, not after.
Knees stay in line with the hips.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Use a small ball instead of the ring
